title: ancistrocladus
intro: Ancistrocladus, commonly known as the Thorny Dragon Tree or Vine, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Ancistrocladaceae. This plant is native to tropical Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The Ancistrocladus plant is reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects.
